title: GCLI-12a: glyph code-map command with the parity port of tiers 1, 2 and 4
description: Child of GCLI-12, split confirmed by the leader on 2026-11-17 after the worker's size read (the whole is well over the ~400-line ceiling). Builds to opum-doc DEC-216 (a4) and opum-cli's CodeMapProducer seam (opum-ai/opum-cli dev, src/context/code-map.ts, and ADR 0008), read by ref only. NOT STARTED: 12a's shape depends on opum-doc's ruling on port-versus-merge (Q1), pending. Slice a of three: the glyph code-map subcommand, emitting the seam's exact {pointers, omissions} JSON, carrying a port of the deterministic producer's tiers (named paths, changed files, git-grep identifiers) with its caps, omission rows and token estimate. estimateTokens is Math.ceil(text.length / 4) over UTF-16 code units, per opum-cli dev 093b0e9 src/adapters/instruction-blocks.ts:122-124; port it exactly and pin the parity test to that commit.

acceptanceCriteria.text: glyph code-map emits exactly the seam {pointers, omissions} shape for task text, source ref and repository, with paths and line ranges in the form the seam consumes, and registers its result kind in the help manifest.

Tiers 1, 2 and 4 match the deterministic producer rules at the pinned opum-cli commit: the 20-file and 2,000-token caps are held in glyph, a token-over pointer is skipped not fatal, and every dropped candidate is named in omissions.
The same repository state, source ref and task text yield byte-identical output.
Tests cover a full clean result, cap truncation and byte-identical repeat runs; bun run check passes.
